## Start here

This hub follows the authoritative TEJ hardware-module sequence. H01, D01, C06, and the Basic Computer Systems layer have complete activity resources. Deeper programming, Linux, and systems lessons remain **Planned** for implementation.

## Lesson-package standard

Each electronics concept is developed as a coordinated package: a teaching deck, a five-question handwritten-work submission document, a worked-answer document, textbook support, and a recommended experiment or an explicit no-lab decision.

- [TEJ Electronics Lesson-Package Style Guide and SOP](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1J3Wf2mPp0UHAIjWphWWiRx7wtk9TbDPhLshayqw_pVE/edit){target="_blank"}
- [Basic Electricity to Basic Computer Systems teaching deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1FD7od7Hi5-tcddWI44oEDzjqIKGQnsp7sOmaokiyH5o/edit){target="_blank"}
- [Circuit Calculations student question and photo-submission document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11ooJTlUf7ckOjkTP9eyJr8FyojWuOHV9-IFjZ5IoCeA/edit){target="_blank"}
- [Circuit Calculations teacher answer document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ux3gAje5iED6vO_gBcF7SbaBJ5TJkV5RqJmkc6XFtDw/edit){target="_blank"}
- [Grob's Basic Electronics Experiments Manual](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15KJmGLXvTh0oivaqnV0SvWB7N64V1soT/view){target="_blank"}
- [Suggested experiments, equipment, software, and consumables](labs/index.qmd#grob-experiment-suggestions)

Google Drive permissions control access to the linked files. The site links to the files but does not host copies of the textbooks or manuals.

## Quick reference and handbook

::: {.tej-download-grid}
::: {.tej-download-card}
### Two-page electronics quick reference

Core formulas and checks for assignments and tests. Long explanations, calculator instructions, and full truth tables stay in the handbook.

[Download quick-reference PDF](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Quick-Reference.pdf){target="_blank"}<br>
[View maintained source](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets/blob/codex/tej-electronics-library/electronics/reference/TEJ-Electronics-Quick-Reference.qmd){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### Electronics reference handbook

Spacious chapters ordered to match the curriculum, including logic, stable digital inputs, PID, motion control, CNC, calculator procedures, and measurement.

[Open accessible handbook HTML](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Reference-Handbook.html){target="_blank"}<br>
[Download handbook PDF](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Reference-Handbook.pdf){target="_blank"}<br>
[View maintained source](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets/blob/codex/tej-electronics-library/electronics/reference/TEJ-Electronics-Reference-Handbook.qmd){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### Basic circuit calculations

Ten questions: Q1 to Q5 required, Q6 to Q10 optional Level 4 evidence.

[Download student worksheet](https://mrandrewandrade.github.io/assets/TEJ_Basic_Circuit_Calculations_Student_Worksheet.pdf){target="_blank"}<br>
[Teacher answer key, restricted](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ux3gAje5iED6vO_gBcF7SbaBJ5TJkV5RqJmkc6XFtDw/edit){target="_blank"}
:::
:::
